events.verdict: Drummond (DET) maintains legal guarding position as Lowry (TOR) creates marginal contact during his drive.
Griffin (DET) and Valanciunas (TOR) make incidental contact with each other during the rebound.
There is inconclusive video evidence determining whether or not the ball, last touched by Griffin (DET), hits the baseline and goes out-of-bounds.

Anunoboy (TOR) makes marginal contact with Griffin's (DET) face during the rebound. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Leonard (TOR) briefly holds Griffin's (DET) right arm as the defensive switch takes place, but does not affect his ability to complete the play.
Griffin (DET) sets the pick on Leonard (TOR) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Leonard (TOR) makes marginal contact with Griffin (DET) prior to the start of his upward shooting motion.
Johnson (DET) reaches in and makes marginal contact with Lowry's (TOR) left arm after his gather.
Galloway (DET) places his left forearm to Lowry's (TOR) front and makes marginal contact after his gather.
Jackson (DET) sets the screen on Anunoby (TOR) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Lowry (TOR) reaches in and cleanly dislodges Galloway (DET) of the ball along the sideline.
Leonard (TOR) reflexively places his arms around Griffin's (DET) midsection as the pick takes place and removes them without affecting his FOM.
Griffin (DET) makes a natural move toward the lane after initial contact with Leonard (TOR) takes place during the pick.
Anunoby (TOR) places his right forearm to Jackson's (DET) front during the drive and makes marginal contact as he begins to gather in the lane.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: The crew communicated with Replay Center official Dedric Taylor to determine who the ball went out of bounds off of. Initially, the ruling was a jump ball, and after review the ruling was overturned to Raptors' ball.
Valanciunas (TOR) makes a natural move toward the basket after initial contact with Johnson (DET) takes place during the pick.
Lowry (TOR) sets the back-screen on Drummond (DET) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Drummond (DET) places his left elbow to Valanciunas' (TOR) front and makes marginal contact as he moves into the lane.
Lowry (TOR) never fully establishes himself in a screening position in Johnson's (DET) path as contact is made, but it is marginal in nature and does not affect his ability to defend.
Galloway (DET) places his right hand to Leonard's (TOR) front and makes marginal contact that does not affect his SQBR.
Leonard (TOR) and Griffin (DET) engage and disengage without affecting the other's FOM as they roll off the pick toward the top of the key.
Leonard (TOR) makes marginal contact with Griffin (DET) as he attempts to get to the pass.
Leonard (TOR) places two hands against Griffin (DET) and makes contact that affects his SQBR during the dribble.
Anunoby (TOR) defends Griffin (DET) during the drive by placing a bent hand and forearm to his backside, maintaining legal guarding position.

Griffin (DET) makes marginal contact with Anunoby's (TOR) head during his follow-through on his shot attempt, but the contact doesn't affect his ability to defend. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Siakam (TOR) makes some contact to Drummond's (DET) backside during the rebound that does not affect his ability to retrieve the rebound.
Johnson (DET) places his right arm around Lowry's (TOR) midsection as the screen takes place and releases without affecting his FOM.
Siakam (TOR) makes marginal contact with Robinson III (DET) that does not affect his FOM as he moves toward the perimeter and back into the lane during the inbound.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Leonard (TOR) dribbles the ball off his foot out of bounds.
Leonard (TOR) makes marginal contact with Jackson (DET) as he cuts across the lane and does not affect his FOM.
Griffin (DET) makes a natural move toward the lane after initial contact with Siakam (TOR) takes place during the screen.
Siakam (TOR) cleanly blocks Robinson III's (DET) shot attempt near the rim.
Bullock (DET) extends his arms slightly from the frame of his body, but keeps them collapsed upon initial contact with Siakam (TOR) during the screen.
Siakam (TOR) and Bullock (DET) engage and disengage along the free throw line.
